source.notes: Electra's official tariff help page states that in Spain charging paid by bank card at the terminal costs 0.59 EUR/kWh VAT included. App/Autocharge pricing is variable between 0.39 and 0.59 EUR/kWh and must not be represented as a fixed direct-app tariff. The official public station site exposes Spanish Electra stations and confirms bank-card payment at the charger.

scope.include: Physical Electra-network charging stations in Spain, only for ad-hoc bank-card payment at the charging terminal.
exclude: Electra app/Autocharge sessions, whose current tariff is station-dependent within 0.39-0.59 EUR/kWh
RFID/eMSP sessions, which may add third-party fees

dynamicOrUnresolved.rule: Do not materialize a fixed tariff. Resolve the exact current station tariff from the official station/app surface when available.

integrationRule: Apply 0.59 EUR/kWh only when the EVSE is confirmed as a physical Electra-network charger in Spain and the simulated payment channel is ad-hoc bank card at the terminal. Never use the range endpoints as station prices and never propagate this tariff to Charge League roaming partners.
